The question specifically asks for memo handlers broadcasting through the hub.

Direct SSEHub.Broadcast calls exist in CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations within memo_service.go and related files. Reaction handlers UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction in reaction_service.go also broadcast through the hub.

The mechanism is Server-Sent Events. It streams text/event-stream at /api/v1/sse.

The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. The SSE endpoint is handled by sse_handler.go. Memo handlers that broadcast include CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.


The hub is `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`; it manages client subscriptions and `Broadcast` sends events to connected browsers. The frontend consumes it via `fetch("/api/v1/sse", ...)` in `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts`.

| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.deleted` |
